notes.title: Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 80's is in the World Ocean Day Steam Sale!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We are super hyped to have our games in the World Ocean Day Steam Sale!  It’s being organized by Games for Waves, and helps to raise money for the WDC- the Whale and Dolphin Conservation.  They do really important work to help protect the ocean and the creatures in it, so we are so pleased to be taking a part in it.[/p][p]
[/p][p]To do our part, we’re donating 50% of the revenue we get from Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 80's from now until June 12th to the WDC![/p][p]
[/p][p]Thanks so much for checking out the event!  [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/worldoceanday2025"]Here’s the link to the showcase itself[/url][/u] so you can check out some other games and support the whales and dolphins even more 🐳[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]50% of our net revenue from this sale (after Steam platform fees) will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. WDC is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705).[/i][/p]

notes.title: We're making a new game called Cozy Beach!
notes.content:
Very cool news everyone, we are working on a new PC game called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489070/Cozy_Beach/?utm_source=80sSteamUpdate]Cozy Beach[/url]!  It's a game where you can water tube, fish and chill with your friends in a tropical paradise.

There's lot of fun stuff to do there!
🏝 Explore a tropical island solo, co-op or online
😸 Customize an adorable animal avatar and dress them up with lots of stylish options.
🎣 Go fishing and try to collect every fish - some might take a couple players to catch!
🔎 Discover treasure maps and hunt for treasure- what kind of cool stuff will you find?
🍍 Collect fruits, and craft fun and silly tropical drinks from the friendly capybara barkeep - the rarer the ingredients, the more exotic the drink!
⭕  Go water tubing in a lazy river around the beautiful tropical island to take in the sights.
🎶 Jam out to sweet tunes on the radio!
And of course, no day at the beach is complete without hanging out and chatting with your friends 👯‍♂️ 

If this sounds like fun, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489070/Cozy_Beach/?utm_source=80sSteamUpdate]go give it a wishlist today[/url] to join us on the peaceful shores of Cozy Beach! 😸 💖

notes.title: New QOL Update!
notes.content:
Greetings detectives!  We've released an update with a couple awesome features!

-Audio Remastering- the audio should be a little more evened out and easier to hear.

-Snap Turning- We added the ability to snap turn to either side, a frequent request!  (We love how it works, thanks for the suggestion!!)

-Debugging- There's always a couple bugs skittering around somewhere.  We squash what we can, when we can.  We're basically VR bug exterminators.

Did you know Grace Hopper found one of the earliest computer bugs in 1947 when an actual moth got into the computer and made it malfunction?!

Anyway!

Oh we also put a shelf under one of the puzzles so if you drop pieces you don't have to kneel down to pick them up off the floor
YW

That's about everything for this update!!  Thanks for reading, and if you like the game, please leave us a review- and let us know if you have any suggestions!!  The reviews help so much, and we love making the game better and better for our fans.

Thanks so much everyone!! Have a radical week!

notes.title: Awesome Achievements Added & A Bodacious Sale to Celebrate!
notes.content:
'Sup, dudes and dudettes!  We're here with a totally tubular update- we added achievements to the game!  Now you can show off your mad gaming skillz- become a Master of Technology, a Wearer of Many Hats, #1 Music Fan or even a Party Popper!

Not only are there cool achievements for completing the game, there are some righteous extra challenges- can you get a high score in Bomb It to become an Explosives Expert?  Can you make it through Cosmic Attackers without a single hit??

Find out today, my bodacious buds!!

To help out, we've put "Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 80's" on sale- so you can check it out for a sweet low price!

Thanks so much for playing- stay well and stay rad!

notes.title: Update Out for Vive Index Controller
notes.content: Hey everyone!  We just released an update that resolves the issue mentioned in the comments.  It's a fix for a game-breaking bug in the last scene that occurs if you're using Vive Index Controllers.  We were able to locate the issue and patch it in this update, so Vive Index users are good to go to play the game!
